ceo_directive: Build evidence budget before execution. Never spend final hostile-attack reserve during exploration.

budget_template.discovery_budget: 1 P005 call (up to 1000 results) + 2-3 P075 calls (ranked queries)
budget_template.reserved_for_final_hostile_attack: 2-3 P018 calls + 1 P007 call (DO NOT SPEND during exploration)

checkpoint_protocol.before_discovery: Check if P005 returns error_code=0 (balance available)
checkpoint_protocol.before_claims: Check if P018 returns error_code=0 for test patent
checkpoint_protocol.before_batch: Confirm at least reserve+batch credits remain
